headword: {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}

definitions.gloss: status of residence; residence qualification; visa status
definitions.explanation: The legal status granted to foreign nationals allowing them to reside in Japan for a specific purpose, such as work, study, or family ties. Defined under Japan's Immigration Control Act.

examples.japanese: {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}の{変更|へんこう}を{申請|しんせい}した。
examples.english: I applied for a change of residence status.

examples.japanese: {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}がないと{日本|にほん}で{働|はたら}けない。
examples.english: You cannot work in Japan without a residence status.

examples.japanese: {留学|りゅうがく}から{就労|しゅうろう}の{在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}に{切|き}り{替|か}えるには、{入管|にゅうかん}で{手続|てつづ}きが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: To switch from a student to a work residence status, you need to complete procedures at the immigration bureau.

notes:
USAGE:
Essential vocabulary for foreigners living in Japan. There are 29 categories of residence status, including {技術|ぎじゅつ}・{人文知識|じんぶんちしき}・{国際業務|こくさいぎょうむ} (engineer/specialist in humanities/international services), {留学|りゅうがく} (student), and {永住者|えいじゅうしゃ} (permanent resident).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}を{取得|しゅとく}する (to obtain a residence status)
- {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}を{更新|こうしん}する (to renew a residence status)
- {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}の{変更|へんこう} (change of residence status)
- {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}{認定|にんてい}{証明書|しょうめいしょ} (Certificate of Eligibility)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ビザ: visa — the entry permit stamped in a passport; technically separate from residence status
- {在留|ざいりゅう}カード: residence card — the physical ID card issued to foreign residents
